AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: A personal to-do app with named lists of items that can be added, completed, deleted and shared. This app manages personal to-do lists: listing lists, adding items, listing items, completing items, deleting items and sharing a list by email. Operational patterns: - Use the list lists action to turn a list name such as "groceries" into its listId before acting on a list. - Use the list items action to find an itemId before completing or deleting an item. Constraints: - Item titles are at most 200 characters.
